title: Tad R. Callister
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth, Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Missionary to the Eastern Atlantic States Mission (1965-1967)
Bachelor's degree in accounting, BYU; Juris Doctorate from UCLA; Master's degree in tax law New York University Law School.
Married Kathryn Saporiti, 1968, Los Angeles California Temple; Parents of six children
Attorney, most recently at Callister & Callister
President of Verdigo Hills Council, Boy Scouts of America
Stake Mission President, Temple Ordinance Worker, Bishop, Stake President and counselor, Regional Representative, Area Seventy
President of Canada Toronto East Mission (2005-2008)
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
